name: release-please-action
description: automated releases based on conventional commits

token.description: GitHub token for creating and grooming release PRs, defaults to using secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN

release-type.description: what type of release is this, one of (ruby, python, node, terraform-module)

path.description: create a release from a path other than the repository's root

target-branch.description: branch to open pull release PR against (detected by default)

config-file.description: where can the config file be found in the project?

manifest-file.description: where can the manifest file be found in the project?

fork.description: If true, send the PR from a fork. This requires the token to be a user that can create forks (e.g. not the default GITHUB_TOKEN)

include-component-in-tag.description: If true, add prefix to tags and branches, allowing multiple libraries to be released from the same repository

proxy-server.description: set proxy sever when you run this action behind a proxy. format is host:port e.g. proxy-host.com:8080

skip-github-release.description: if set to true, then do not try to tag releases

skip-github-pull-request.description: if set to true, then do not try to open pull requests

skip-labeling.description: if set to true, then do not try to label the PR

changelog-host.description: The proto://host where commits live. Default `https://github.com`
